title: Start with a ready-made server

body.text: The easiest way is to use a
someone has already built — connecting a documents folder, a database, or a service you use regularly. Set it up in an MCP-capable app, then start asking tasks that reference that data.

example: Connect an MCP to the company documents folder → 'find the vacation-leave policy from the HR documents'

title: Combine multiple servers

body.text: You can connect several servers at once, letting the AI work across systems — pull data from a database + write a summary to a file, in one command. This is where MCP is powerful: combining multiple tools to work continuously.

example: Pull sales from the database + create a summary report file + save it to a folder, in one command
